name: Shoppes at Lac De Ville
summary: Shoppes at Lac De Ville is a community shopping center in Rochester, NY, featuring a convenient mix of grocery, retail, dining, and service tenants anchored by Tops supermarket. The center serves local residents with everyday essentials and specialty offerings including fitness facilities, personal care services, and diverse dining options.
demographics: Shoppes at Lac De Ville serves the southern Rochester suburban market, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area includes a mix of established homeowners, young families, and working professionals with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $100,000+. Primary shoppers are convenience-oriented consumers seeking everyday necessities, dining options, and personal services within a neighborhood setting. The center benefits from its location on Clinton Avenue South, drawing from both the immediate Brighton community and broader Monroe County residents seeking accessible shopping and dining options.
description: Shoppes at Lac De Ville is a well-established community shopping center located at 1900 Clinton Avenue South in Rochester, New York, serving the southern suburbs with a diverse mix of retail, dining, and service offerings. Owned and managed by Baldwin Real Estate Corporation, this neighborhood center has become a convenient destination for local residents seeking everyday essentials and specialty services. The center features a strong anchor presence with Tops supermarket and AutoZone, complemented by popular retailers including Dollar General and Liberty Wine & Liquor. Dining options range from casual favorites like Mesquite Grill and Rita's Italian Ice to the newly opened Goosepark Bubble Tea and international cuisine at Seoul Drop. The center's service tenant mix is particularly robust, featuring fitness facilities like Cromartie Fitness & Wellness Therapy and Rochester Top Team, personal care services including Bolsa Nails and Prince & Princess Hair Salon, and essential services such as USPS, Julian's Dry Cleaners, and Thimble Tailor. With upcoming additions like Autism Learning Partners and Cardamom, Shoppes at Lac De Ville continues to evolve and expand its offerings to meet the changing needs of the Rochester community.
